first_missing_criterion: official record-level feature where Polygon/MultiPolygon is explicitly the physical building footprint and the same record carries an evidence-bearing building type/use field. Historic England NHLE layer 3 is an official listed-building polygon layer, but its schema exposes ListEntry/Name/Grade/date/location fields rather than current use/type, and NHLE 'Listed Buildings' can include non-building structures; the <=50 Exeter-bbox feature payload was not retrievable through the available public fetch surface.
